name: Unbound Flourishing
oracle_text:
Whenever you cast a permanent spell with a mana cost that contains {X}, double the value of X.
Whenever you cast an instant or sorcery spell or activate an ability, if that spell's mana cost or that ability's activation cost contains {X}, copy that spell or ability. You may choose new targets for the copy.
blocked_sentences: Whenever you cast a permanent spell with a mana cost that contains {X}, double the value of X.

Whenever you cast an instant or sorcery spell or activate an ability, if that spell's mana cost or that ability's activation cost contains {X}, copy that spell or ability. You may choose new targets for the copy.

needs.what: an op run by a spell_cast trigger that rewrites the announced X of the triggering spell on the stack (here X := 2X), so the permanent resolves with the doubled X for every 'X' it reads (counters, ETB values)
needs.why_existing_wont_do: No op touches a stack object's chosen X; the `x` value only reads it, and `cost.x_value` fixes X at announcement for the card's own cost, not another spell's

needs.what: a trigger filter for spell_cast meaning 'its mana cost contains {X}', and for ability_activated meaning 'the activated ability's activation cost contains {X}', so one trigger can fire on either and copy_spell / copy_ability the cause
needs.why_existing_wont_do: The `mana_cost` filter key is an equality test against whole printed costs (has_printed_cost/printed_cost_is), not a contains-{X} test, and ability_activated has no filter on the ability's activation cost at all
